purpose: Frozen facts about the client's existing building (omar.rvt). Any change comes from a new survey, not Revit. Read through archpipe.model.geometry_existing.

omar-inventory.json.note: Revit 2027 read of omar.rvt: 15 structural columns (ids, bbox), 3 floors, levels, grids (0), framing (0), category counts. U15.

omar-wet.json.note: Wet-room probe of the existing building (U16).

omar-stairzone.json.gz.note: Stair-zone probe of the existing building (U16); gzip of the original bytes.

omar-2027-extract.nomesh.json.gz.note: Full Revit 2027 extract of omar.rvt (walls 63, openings, casework, furniture, lighting, wall types, levels, site) minus mesh triangles.

notes: omar-extract.json (Revit 2025 attempt) was a 0-byte file and is not frozen.
omar-2027-extract.json is 425 MB because of meshes; the stripped copy keeps every placement, size, level and type field.
